main_text.p: pueri & fœminæ, ventriculum potius vix dū incoatæ maturitatis explentes.

Qui humanioribus dant operam lite- ris à fructuum crudorum efu plane abstinebunt, fenfus enim heberant, mentis arcem caligine replent, capita infirmiora admodum conflictant, cutimq; {fcabie vlceribusq;} commaculant.

Belle matura, quæ in hiemem & æstate tem feruari poslunt, commendantur, falutares enim vitæ hominum præstant vsus. Coctæ præterea, vel tofta ex butyro cum faccharo falubriora funt, inque cibis magis grata. Generofa tamen quæ funt, raro ignem exuunt periuntur, cruda enim à magnatibus edunt tur, ignobiliora, vt acerba & auftera focum defiderant, coctione enim aftrictionem auferitatemque amittunt.

Quapropter pernitiofum non est, vt quidam volunt, adaluum emolliendam potius ma coćta primo cibo & mensaassumere, præsertim vero dulcia, quæ medium tempe- ramentum obtinent, adque calorem nonni- hil vergunt: cætera gelidioris funt naturæ, inprimis vero fera & syl uestria, quibus ferox quoque & sapor, & fuccus est. Acida, au- fteraque stomacho robur afferunt, astrin- gendoque aluum fluentem sistunt, stoma- chique vomitiones compescunt præsertim acerba, coćta ac parata.

page.notes: Printed text is set in small, damaged type; many words are uncertain, and the transcription of the middle lines is a best reading and should be checked against the scan. Marginal note "NB." on the left margin, with its marker at the start of the paragraph at line 11 ("periuntur"). Parts of lines are obscured by show-through and creases; the "{fcabie ...}" bracketed phrase and the text "Coctæ præterea" and "ignem exuunt" are doubtful readings. The bottom word "Infipi-" is a catchword-like hyphenated fragment and is given as a foot line. Words marked [?] were not clearly legible and have not been marked individually due to the poor scan quality.
